children.text: The Basic Workspace serves as a showcase for basic A12 modeling features. Modelers can explore examples of many of the features of A12 in this workspace:

children.text: It has two rather simple document types, Person and Company, that can be linked by a 1:n relationship. The UI elements to maintain these links are different on both sides. A Table List and a Dual Pane are used on the Company side, while a Drop Down Selection is used on the Person side.

children.text: The module "Invoice" features a more complex Document Model with Computation and Validation Rules. It models an invoice with a billing and a shipping address, order and delivery dates, a product list and payment information. Some parts are included to show a certain feature, and do not claim to be meaningful.

props.html: This workspace uses Role Based Access Control (RBAC). Users, Roles and Access Rights are defined by the files inside the "auth" folder. These Access Rights ultimately determine which operations the User can do.

props.label:
There is a special Access Right "MODEL_MANAGE", that allows a Role to add, change or read models even if the Role is not listed in the model. 
This Access Right is assigned to the Roles "modeler" and "systemAdmin". Hence, these Roles (and the Users "ba" and "admin") can work with the models although they are not  listed in the model files.
